title: 13C6-Lysine-labelled mouse serum N-terminomics
projectDescription: To investigate the putative lifetime of proteolytically cleaved protein fragments in mouse serum, wildtype mice were fed with 13C6-Lysine for 1 or 2 weeks and the incorporation of 13C6-Lysine into proteins/protein fragments was investigated to achieve lifetime estimations for the fragment(s') generation.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Mouse serum samples were withdrawn after 1 and 2 weeks of 13C6-Lysine feeding and snap-frozen. Diluted mouse serum was lysed in 4% SDS/0.1M HEPES pH 7.4/2.5 mM EDTA + Roche cOmplete protease inhibitors and processed with the HUNTER method (Weng, Demir et al., MCP, 2019). Protein-level labelling was performed as single-channel dimethyl-labelling with 13C6-formaldehyde, before protein samples were SP3 purified (Hughes et al., Nat Protocols, 2019) and digested with trypsin (protease:protein ratio 1:100) over night. Subsequently, digested peptides were hydrophobically labelled with the aldehyde undecanal, depleted and fractionated via C18 spin-columns (basic fractionation with 8% and 40% ACN in AmOH) to purify the N-termini afterwards. 1µg of samples was separated with a two-column setup (Thermo PepMap 100 pre-column & Aurora Ultimate 25cm column) on an Ultimate 3000 RSLC nano-HPLC coupled to a Thermo Exploris480 MS equipped with a FAIMS Pro device. Measurements were taken in DIA mode with a 2h gradient at 50 °C with two FAIMS CVs at -45 & -65V: the effective separation range of the gradient (A=H2O+0.1%FA, B=ACN+0.1%FA) was 8-25% B for 80min., 25-35%B for 10 min. at 400 nL/min. MS1 data was acquired at a resolution of 120k 350-1350 m/z & normalized AGC target of 300%. MF2 data was recorded at a resolution of 30k with 40 25 m/z windows from 400-1000 m/z & normalized AGC target of 300%
dataProcessingProtocol: Acquired raw files were analyzed with FragPipe v21.1 (MSFragger v4.0) with the build-in DiaNN v.1.8.2_beta_8 and library-free plexDIA approach utilizing a fixed N-termini search strategy: only dimethylated lysine & N-termini (+34.0631 for 13CD2O/NaBH3CN) and cysteine carbamidomethylation (+57.0216) were set as fixed modifications. 13C6-labelled lysines (+6.0200996) and oxidations on methionine (+15.9949) were set as variable modifications. Data evaluation was performed with MANTI v5.5 as well as R v4.3.1.
